subject.title: fix(codex): expose assistant completion idle timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.turnAssistantCompletionIdleTimeoutMs` as a public advanced setting?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the setting works, but repository policy sets a high bar for new `openclaw.json` surface and only a Codex owner can accept the long-term support and compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the public setting
options.body: Keep the current narrow patch and merge after exact-head checks, treating the key and its 10000 ms default as a supported Codex plugin contract.

options.title: Keep the timer internal
options.body: Decline the public key and retain the existing direct runtime option for controlled harness validation without expanding operator configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept the public setting
recommendation.body: Keep the current narrow patch and merge after exact-head checks, treating the key and its 10000 ms default as a supported Codex plugin contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently edited this PR head to add default coverage and preserve runtime-option compatibility, and their history includes the relevant timeout seams.
